title: Binance Futures Will Cancel USDⓈ-M FTTBUSD Delisting and Launch Multiple USDⓈ-M  Perpetual Contracts
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will cancel the USDⓈ-M FTTBUSD perpetual contract  delisting plan  scheduled for 2022-05-19 09:00 AM (UTC), and launch multiple USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts with up to 20x leverage. Detailed schedule as below: USDⓈ-M NEARBUSD perpetual contract at 2022-05-17 03:30 AM (UTC) USDⓈ-M GMTBUSD perpetual contract at 2022-05-18 03:30 AM (UTC) USDⓈ-M APEBUSD perpetual contract at 2022-05-19 03:30 AM (UTC) Please note: USDⓈ-M NEARBUSD, GMTBUSD and APEBUSD perpetual contracts are BUSD-margined futures contracts that use BUSD as collateral. Users will be able to select between 1-20x leverage. Multi-Asset mode  is enabled for USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts. Users can use USDT as margin for BUSD-margined perpetual contracts.
